item.title: lucie koko
item.description:
I really don’t know what to do here. But here’s a new blogpost. If I have to summarize what happened between the last blogpost, I Want to Disappear, and now, it’d be:

  • I’ve survived over 1 year of being a NEET without killing myself somehow.
  • I was diagnosed with autism last month & have been doing EMDR therapy for three weeks.
    And that’s all I’ve thought to share.

For housekeeping, I went from using the minindie Hugo theme to using a static site generator called Makko. It seems easier to use so far. I’ve lost confidence in my ability to post on X, The Everything App without frying myself, so everything important to say will be on this site. See you next post.
